questions.prompt: As 7d 2c compared with Jh Th 9h is…

choices.text: Drier. Fewer turns complete a straight or a flush.

questions.explanation: Ace-high disconnected rainbow is static. Jack-ten-nine with a flush draw is dynamic.

questions.prompt: Button opened, big blind called. Flop 9h 8h 7c. Who has more of the nuts?

choices.text: The big blind. Straights and two pair show up more in a calling range.
The button, because position is the nuts
Neither. The nuts are always pocket aces
The player who folded under the gun

questions.explanation: Nut advantage can sit with the caller even when the raiser has more overpairs.

questions.prompt: Range advantage and nut advantage differ because…

choices.text: Range advantage is who has more strong hands overall. Nut advantage is who has more of the absolute best hands.
Nut advantage is only stack size
Range advantage ignores position and preflop action

questions.explanation: On A72 rainbow the raiser often has both. On 876 the caller can have the nuts while the raiser still has more overpairs.

questions.prompt: A blank turn on K72 rainbow is a card that…

choices.text: Does not complete many draws or change who holds the nuts.

questions.explanation: A deuce, seven, or king pairs the board. A low offsuit brick such as a three changes less.
